_comment: TEMPLATE. The ready-to-host copy (no _comment key) is site/.well-known/assetlinks.json at the repo root; see site/README.md. Serve it at BOTH https://pantryrun.app/.well-known/assetlinks.json and https://www.pantryrun.app/.well-known/assetlinks.json (Content-Type application/json, no redirect) so the android:autoVerify filter for https://pantryrun.app/invite and https://www.pantryrun.app/invite opens the app without a chooser. Replace the sha256_cert_fingerprints value with the SHA-256 fingerprint of the APP SIGNING certificate. With Google Play App Signing (recommended), copy it from Play Console > Test and release > Setup > App integrity > App signing key certificate; add the upload key's fingerprint as a second entry if you also install upload-signed builds directly. For a local keystore: keytool -list -v -keystore pantryrun-upload.keystore -alias pantryrun-upload | grep SHA256.
